about:
Rich Industries Import Auto Parts has operated from Kansas City, Missouri since 1968. The company was founded as a source for new and used automotive components and has remained at the same Winchester Avenue location for over five decades. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The business supplies new and used auto parts with a focus on import vehicles, and supplements its inventory with nationwide parts locating and direct shipping services. It also runs an import auto restoration program and sells used and salvage vehicles. The facility provides cut sheets for unibody, full-frame, SUV, minivan, and truck configurations to aid part identification, and uses the Car-Part Interchange system for cross-referencing. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include individual vehicle owners, repair shops, and restoration specialists seeking import and domestic parts across the United States. The company emphasizes service to the Kansas City metro area while fulfilling orders nationally through its eBay store and direct shipping.

Rich Industries highlights a 90-day warranty on all parts, extended warranty options, and a commitment to customer service that aims to simplify parts procurement. The firm positions itself as more than a parts counter by offering restoration, salvage sales, and locating services under one roof.
